brief:
Facts: For the quarter ended 2026-09-30, primary filings visually verified by Codex show MRPL (standalone) with year-on-year growth in both revenue and PAT; CEATLTD (standalone) with revenue growth but lower PAT and lower PBT before exceptional items; and ICICIGI (insurer statutory) with growth in gross written premium and PAT alongside a higher combined ratio and broadly similar solvency ratio (fundamental-MRPL-20260930, fundamental-CEATLTD-20260930, fundamental-ICICIGI-20260930).

Interpretations (hypotheses, unconfirmed): MRPL's result may reflect refining-cycle leverage; CEATLTD's divergence may reflect cost or mix pressure; ICICIGI's profit growth may lean on non-underwriting drivers. Causes are not evidenced.

Gaps: no segment, cost, reserving or consolidated detail; single quarter establishes a baseline only. No industrial debt test is applied to the insurer.

All three dossiers are provisional and unqualified. Ownership: Claude research; Codex verification. Next check: quarter ending 2026-12-31.
